BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, tseʼĕtsâʼ is the word for issue, i.e. produce, children. It appears 11 times in Scripture, including Isaiah 44:3 and Isaiah 61:9.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that tseʼĕtsâʼ is no accident in Scripture — God put it there on purpose.
